title: 'Watching the Grass Grow' Is Not Fun
credits: Anna Matteo wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: And now Words and Their Stories from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 现在，来自美国之音英语学习栏目的“词汇及其故事”。

sentences.en: Springtime is a time of renewal and growth.
sentences.zh: 春天是一个更新与生长的季节。

sentences.en: Many plants end their long winter sleep and form new buds and shoots.
sentences.zh: 许多植物结束了漫长的冬季休眠，萌发出新的芽和枝。

sentences.en: Beautiful flowers will soon be showing their bright colors.
sentences.zh: 美丽的花朵很快将绽放出鲜艳的色彩。

sentences.en: And the grass will grow thicker and greener again.
sentences.zh: 而草地也将再次变得更加浓密、更加青翠。

sentences.en: Some flowers bloom in a very noticeable way but that is not the case with grass.
sentences.zh: 有些花的绽放方式格外引人注目，但草却并非如此。

sentences.en: Imagine you are sitting in a grassy field.
sentences.zh: 想象你正坐在一片长满草的田野里。

sentences.en: And you have only one job – to watch the grass grow.
sentences.zh: 而你只有一项工作——看着草生长。

sentences.en: That does not sound very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这听起来并不怎么有趣。

sentences.en: In fact, it sounds really boring.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这听起来真的很无聊。

sentences.en: That idea is what gives us the expression “like watching grass grow.”
sentences.zh: 正是这个想法给了我们“like watching grass grow”这个表达。

sentences.en: We use this expression to describe an experience that is uninteresting.
sentences.zh: 我们用这个表达来描述一种无趣的经历。

sentences.en: Another good word to describe it is tedious.
sentences.zh: 另一个能很好地形容它的词是“tedious”（乏味的）。

sentences.en: We use this expression in many situations.
sentences.zh: 我们常常在许多场合使用这个表达。

sentences.en: Let’s hear a few examples:
sentences.zh: 让我们来听几个例子：

sentences.en: After the politician won his campaign, he gave a two-hour long acceptance speech. Two hours!
sentences.zh: 那位政治家赢得选举后，发表了一场长达两小时的获胜感言。两个小时！

sentences.en: It was as much fun as watching grass grow.
sentences.zh: 那乐趣简直和看草生长一模一样。

sentences.en: I really don’t like watching long sports games.
sentences.zh: 我真的很不喜欢看长时间的体育比赛。

sentences.en: It’s like watching grass grow.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像在看草生长。

sentences.en: Now, grass grows on the ground all the time.
sentences.zh: 现在，草无时无刻不在地面上生长。

sentences.en: And usually, we don’t give it much thought.
sentences.zh: 通常，我们并不会太多地去想它。

sentences.en: If you stand in one place for a long time, the grass will continue to grow under your feet.
sentences.zh: 如果你长时间站在原地不动，你脚下的草会继续生长。

sentences.en: For people who are always active, always moving, always on-the-go, we can say they don't let grass grow under their feet.
sentences.zh: 对于总是忙碌、总是活动、总是奔波的人来说，我们可以说他们“脚底下都长草了”。

sentences.en: We can also say beneath their feet.
sentences.zh: 我们也可以说“脚底下都长草了”。

sentences.en: And sometimes we use this expression as a command.
sentences.zh: 有时我们会把这句话当作命令来使用。

sentences.en: Let’s hear some examples:
sentences.zh: 让我们听几个例子：

sentences.en: Don’t let the grass grow beneath your feet.
sentences.zh: 别让你脚底下长草了。

sentences.en: Get back to work.
sentences.zh: 快回去工作。

sentences.en: She certainly doesn’t let the grass grow under her feet.
sentences.zh: 她 certainly 不会让脚底下长草。

sentences.en: She’s been traveling non-stop for over a year.
sentences.zh: 她已经连续不停地旅行了快一年了。

sentences.en: And that’s all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们这期“Words and Their Stories”的全部内容。

sentences.en: Until next time, I’m Anna Matteo.
sentences.zh: 下次再见，我是安娜·马特奥。

glossary.def: the beginnings of a flower or a leaf on the branch of a plant
new plant growth, especially from seeds or close to the ground as in the case with grass
tiresome because it takes a long time and is repetitive
